gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare commencing at its junction with Tai Yip Street about 225 m. south of Siu Yip Street, running in an easterly direction for a distance of about 83 m. and terminating at its junction with Kwun Tong Road, as shown coloured red on Drawing No. KH 2008/1.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道起點在兆業街以南約二百二十五公尺之處與大業街會合，向東行約八十三公尺，終點與觀塘道會合；其位置在 KH 2008/1 號圖則上用紅色標明。
